subject: Mutual Action Plan — security gating and evidence sprint for Bridgeway evaluation
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@bridgeway.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellison <t.ellison@bridgeway.com>, security@bridgeway.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval kickoff + MAP request (SOC2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Hi Lukas —

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday. Bridgeway is excited to run a short evaluation, and our security committee asked for a clear mutual action plan that calls out gating criteria and evidence owners. Specifically they want: SOC 2 readiness confirmation, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire timeline, a DPA redline window focused on EU data residency (we have EU customers), and explicit data retention tiers.

Can you share a MAP with proposed milestones and an estimate for an evidence sprint? Preferably something we can review by end of week so procurement can slot the legal review.

High level constraints:
- Target procurement decision: by 2027-06-10
- Evidence sprint window: ideally 2–3 weeks in May/June
- Bridgeway contacts: Aisha Khan (security lead), Tom Ellison (procurement)

Thanks — looking forward to the plan.

Cheers,
Aisha Khan
Head of Security Programs
Bridgeway Finance

Attachment: none
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@bridgeway.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff + MAP request (SOC2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a first-cut MAP (Bridgeway-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that maps milestones to evidence owners and acceptance criteria. Summary below:

Planned timeline (proposed)
- Week 1 (5/24–5/28): SIG/CAIQ questionnaire kickoff + Bridgeway to confirm evidence owners
- Week 2 (5/31–6/4): Evidence collection sprint (SOC2 artifacts, config screenshots, network diagrams)
- Week 3 (6/7–6/11): Legal/DPA redline window and follow-ups; sign-off meeting on 6/10

Gating criteria
- SOC2: provide most recent Type II report or in-progress Evidence Tracker entries for CCs in scope
- SIG/CAIQ: completed spreadsheet responses + 3 technical walkthrough checkpoints with Rishi
- DPA: target redline turnaround within 5 business days after initial comments
- Data retention: we propose 3 retention tiers (operational logs 90 days, account metadata 24 months, backups 12 months with controlled access) — happy to adjust for EU residency needs.

Evidence owners (proposed)
- Bridgeway: Aisha Khan (security), designated application owners for config exports
- Redwood: Rishi Malhotra (security lead) for SOC/SIG technical correlation; Laura Bennett (legal) on DPA and contract items; Lukas for program coordination

If that looks sane I can lock the dates and invite a short weekly stand to unblock evidence. I’ve uploaded the MAP draft here: https://docs.redwood.com/teams/lukas/bridgeway/MAP-v1

Lukas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Bridgeway-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (worksheet: milestones, evidence matrix)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@bridgeway.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff + MAP request (SOC2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Lukas / Aisha —

Couple legal items to call out so the MAP has the right expectations:
- DPA: I’ve included an initial redline that preserves EU residency options. We generally propose a limited carve for EU data processing with subprocessor transparency; see attached DPA-redlines-LauraB.docx
- Retention: for EU personal data we should align on a maximum 24-month default, with the ability to narrow per dataset. Please confirm if Bridgeway requires onshore-only storage for EU customer PII (that will affect deployment options).
- KMS: Bridgeway asked about key management — we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integration (note this as optional in the MAP under risk mitigations).

I will not block the timeline but we should preserve a 5-business-day turnaround window for DPA comments in the MAP to avoid surprise delays.

—Laura
Deputy General Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA-redlines-LauraB.docx (summary of EU residency clause + KMS options)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@bridgeway.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bridgeway.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval kickoff + MAP request (SOC2, SIG, DPA, retention)

Aisha / team —

Quick technical notes to make the evidence sprint efficient:
- SIG/CAIQ: please send the Bridgeway-preferred SIG format (if you have a prefilled sheet) before 5/24. I can pre-map our evidence artifacts to the SIG control IDs.
- SOC2 artifacts: I will prepare a SOC2 evidence index (control-to-artifact mapping) and a short readout deck. I’ll need screenshots/exports for the customer-specific config items (RBAC lists, VPC peering, logging sink settings).
- Data residency: if onshore-only is required for EU tenants, we need to confirm region & will propose a dedicated deployment cadence (adds 5–7 business days to provisioning).

Operational ask: can Bridgeway provide a primary Slack or Teams channel for rapid artifact exchange for the two-week sprint? It dramatically reduces the email back-and-forth.

I’ll schedule two 30-min tech checkpoints during the sprint (once kickoff, once mid-sprint).

—Rishi
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Tom Ellison <t.ellison@bridgeway.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@bridgeway.com>, security@bridgeway.com
Date: Tue, 26 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — security gating and evidence sprint for Bridgeway evaluation

Lukas / team —

Appreciate the fast turnaround on the MAP and pointers. Bridgeway confirms the following:
- We accept the proposed sprint cadence and will aim to provide SIG-prefilled answers by 5/24.
- Evidence sprint approved for 5/31–6/11 (two-week core window plus buffer)
- We need the DPA redline back to our counsel within 5 business days after we share comments (aligns with Laura’s note)
- On EU residency: Bridgeway requires that EU customer PII be stored in EU regions; please include a short deployment addendum if provisioning EU-only storage will require extra lead time.

Next steps for Redwood: confirm point contacts, populate the MAP with the final dates, and share a short DocuSign link for the MAP acceptance/statement-of-work if applicable. Also confirm whether a customer-managed KMS is required for EU data — we need that note in the SOW.

Tom Ellison
Senior Procurement Manager
Bridgeway Finance
